const esc=s=>String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]));
const mounted=new WeakSet();

 let at=initial,fallback=initialFallback,timer=null,feedback='',openDialog=null;
 const count=config.steps.length;
 function steps(){return config.steps.map(s=>{const n={...s,action:{...s.action}};if(fallback&&n.action.type==='fill'){n.action.text=config.fallback;n.reality='已切换为手动读取：复制本分支整段指令，粘贴到真实 Codex 消息框。先核对 Skill 路径，再发送；这一方法不等于验证了自动发现。';n.detail='本分支改为直接读取本地 Skill 文件。点击消息框填入替代指令；不要声称自动发现成功。'}if(fallback&&n.action.type==='send'){n.action.message=config.fallbackMessage;n.action.manual=true}return n})}
 function state(){const s={files:Object.fromEntries(config.files.map(f=>[f.path,f.content])),open:new Set(config.open||[]),hidden:!!config.showHidden,selected:null,screen:'chat',input:'',messages:[],workspace:false};for(const step of steps().slice(0,at)){const a=step.action;switch(a.type){case'workspace':s.workspace=true;break;case'folder':s.open.add(a.path);break;case'hidden':s.hidden=true;break;case'file':s.selected=a.path;s.screen='file';break;case'chat':s.screen='chat';break;case'new':s.screen='chat';s.input='';s.messages=[];break;case'fill':s.screen='chat';s.input=a.text;break;case'send':s.messages.push({role:'user',text:s.input},{role:'assistant',text:a.message});s.input='';for(const f of a.files||[])s.files[f.path]=f.content;s.screen='chat';break;}}return s}

 function advance(){if(at<count){at++;feedback='';if(at>=count)stop();render()}}
 function tree(s){const root={children:{}};Object.keys(s.files).forEach(path=>{const parts=path.split('/');let node=root;parts.forEach((part,i)=>{const p=parts.slice(0,i+1).join('/');if(!node.children[part])node.children[part]={path:p,name:part,children:{},file:i===parts.length-1};node=node.children[part]})});
 function walk(node,depth){return Object.values(node.children).sort((a,b)=>(a.file-b.file)||a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).filter(x=>s.hidden||!x.name.startsWith('.')).map(x=>{const target=(x.file?'file:':'folder:')+x.path;return `<button type="button" data-hit="${esc(target)}" style="padding-left:${8+depth*11}px" class="${s.selected===x.path?'cd-selected':''}"${x.file?'':` aria-expanded="${s.open.has(x.path)}"`} title="${esc(x.path)}"><span class="cd-file-icon">${x.file?'≡':s.open.has(x.path)?'⌄':'›'}</span><span>${esc(x.name)}</span></button>`+(!x.file&&s.open.has(x.path)?walk(x,depth+1):'')}).join('')};return walk(root,0)}

 host.querySelectorAll('[data-hit]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(done){feedback='演示已结束，点“重来”重新练习；真实文件需要到自己的 Codex 中查看。';render();return}if(b.dataset.hit===steps()[at].target){stop();advance()}else{feedback='这一步请点击蓝色标记：'+steps()[at].title;render()}}));

 }
 render();
 const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{if(entries[0]&&!entries[0].isIntersecting&&timer){stop();if(host.isConnected)render()}},{threshold:0});observer.observe(host);
 const onVisibility=()=>{if(document.hidden){stop();if(host.isConnected)render()}};
 document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',onVisibility);
 return ()=>{stop();observer.disconnect();document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',onVisibility)};
}
function scan(root=document){root.querySelectorAll('[data-real-copy]').forEach(b=>{if(b.dataset.ready)return;b.dataset.ready='1';b.addEventListener('click',async()=>{const box=b.closest('details'),status=box.querySelector('[data-real-status]');try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(box.querySelector('pre').textContent);status.textContent='已复制'}catch{status.textContent='复制受限，请选中上方整段文字复制'}})});root.querySelectorAll('.cd-host').forEach(host=>{if(mounted.has(host))return;const data=host.querySelector('.cd-data');if(data){try{mount(host,JSON.parse(data.textContent))}catch(e){host.innerHTML='<p class="cd-noscript">演示暂时无法加载，请先使用下方图解与实操指令。</p>';console.error(e)}}})}
